# Fly GACA

> Fly GACA is an independent, educational platform and open regulatory library for Saudi civil aviation (GACAR). It helps pilots, flight instructors, student pilots and aviation professionals find and study the regulations, with calculators, study tools and an AI flight instructor (Captain Adel) that cites the exact GACAR Part and section. It is bilingual (English/Arabic, RTL) and free to study.

Important: Fly GACA is **not affiliated with GACA** (the General Authority of Civil Aviation). It is a study and reference aid — it never replaces the official source, and every regulatory answer points to the exact Part/section to verify against the official GACA publication.

Operator: Fly GACA is operated by BDA Company International (شركة بدع الدولية), a Saudi limited-liability company — CR 7030976893, VAT 311415259500003, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## Library (GACAR regulations & reference)

- [Reference Library](https://flygaca.com/library): Search all 74 GACAR Parts plus FAA, ICAO and GACA reference handbooks, full-text and deep-linked to the exact section.
- [GACAR Part 61 — Pilot certification](https://flygaca.com/library/part-61): Licensing, ratings and recency requirements.
- [GACAR Part 67 — Medical](https://flygaca.com/library/part-67): Aeromedical certification standards.
- [GACAR Part 91 — General operating & flight rules](https://flygaca.com/library/part-91): VFR/IFR rules, equipment, oxygen, minima.
- [VFR Charts](https://flygaca.com/library/charts): Saudi visual charts from the GACA AIP.

## Tools (flight calculators)

- [Flight Tools & Calculators](https://flygaca.com/tools): 55 free calculators — crosswind, density altitude, TAS, weight & balance, METAR/TAF decoders, and more.
- [Kingdom Airspace HUD](https://flygaca.com/hud): An interactive, fully simulated training view of Saudi airspace — animated scenario traffic over real AIP CTR/TMA zones. Not real air traffic.

## Guides

- [Learn hub](https://flygaca.com/learn): All guides, study modes and reference tools in one place.
- [How to become a pilot in Saudi Arabia](https://flygaca.com/guides/how-to-become-a-pilot-in-saudi-arabia): The path from student to airline pilot, citing GACAR Part 61 and Part 67.
- [Saudi PPL requirements](https://flygaca.com/guides/saudi-ppl-requirements): Age, medical, training and tests for a private pilot certificate.
- [Saudi CPL requirements](https://flygaca.com/guides/saudi-cpl-requirements): Commercial pilot eligibility and the Appendix D experience route.
- [Saudi instrument rating](https://flygaca.com/guides/saudi-instrument-rating): The GACAR §61.89 routes to an instrument rating.
- [ATPL requirements](https://flygaca.com/guides/atpl-requirements): Airline transport pilot age and the §61.181 hours.
- [Drone / UAS rules in KSA](https://flygaca.com/guides/drone-uas-rules-in-ksa): GACAR Part 107 limits for civil small unmanned aircraft.
- [Foreign licence conversion](https://flygaca.com/guides/foreign-license-conversion-to-gaca): Converting an FAA/EASA licence to GACA.
- [GACAR explained](https://flygaca.com/guides/gacar-explained): How the regulations are organized and cited.

## Study & exam prep

- [Study & Exam Prep](https://flygaca.com/learn?tab=practice): GACAR quizzes (12 domains), flashcards, ground school and a timed mock exam — every answer linked to the cited regulation.
- [Aviation glossary](https://flygaca.com/library/glossary): Bilingual definitions of the GACAR and aviation terms used across the library.
- [Aerodrome directory](https://flygaca.com/tools/aerodromes): Runways, frequencies and elevation for Saudi and regional aerodromes.

## Captain Adel (AI flight instructor)

- [Captain Adel](https://flygaca.com/chat): Ask questions about Saudi GACAR and get answers grounded in the regulation with the exact Part and section cited.

## Arabic (العربية)

Every page has an Arabic twin under the `/ar` prefix — a distinct, crawlable document, not a
query-string variant. The regulatory text itself is published in English; the Arabic pages carry
Arabic navigation, metadata and guide content.

- [Fly GACA بالعربية](https://flygaca.com/ar): The Arabic home.
- [المكتبة التنظيمية](https://flygaca.com/ar/library): The GACAR library in Arabic.
- [الكابتن عادل](https://flygaca.com/ar/chat): Ask about GACAR in Arabic and get the Part and section cited.
- [أدلة الطيران](https://flygaca.com/ar/learn): Guides and study tools in Arabic.
